skills.name: Account portfolio management
skills.description: Managing a portfolio of customer accounts to meet retention and growth targets in a fast-paced environment.
skills.assessment_scope: Planning, prioritising, and executing day-to-day management of multiple accounts while hitting revenue and service goals.

skills.name: Customer relationship building
skills.description: Developing and maintaining strong, trust-based relationships with clients focused on long-term success.
skills.assessment_scope: Ability to build rapport, understand client context, and maintain engagement over time.

skills.name: Customer success orientation
skills.description: Focusing on client outcomes and value to ensure customer success and satisfaction.
skills.assessment_scope: Understanding customer goals and aligning solutions and support to achieve them.

skills.name: Revenue growth and upselling
skills.description: Identifying and driving opportunities to grow revenue within existing accounts.
skills.assessment_scope: Recognising growth opportunities, positioning additional products or services, and closing incremental business.

skills.name: Communication skills
skills.description: Clearly and persuasively communicating with clients and internal stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
skills.assessment_scope: Explaining complex or sensitive information, adjusting style to audience, and confirming understanding.

skills.name: Self-starting and motivation
skills.description: Working proactively and independently to achieve account and growth goals without close supervision.
skills.assessment_scope: Initiative-taking, ownership of outcomes, and persistence in a fast-paced, growing environment.

skills.name: Stakeholder expectation management
skills.description: Setting, aligning, and managing expectations with clients and internal partners.
skills.assessment_scope: Negotiating timelines, scope, and priorities while maintaining satisfaction and trust.

skills.name: Issue resolution and follow-through
skills.description: Handling customer issues and requests promptly and ensuring satisfactory resolution.
skills.assessment_scope: Diagnosing issues, coordinating responses, and following through until closure.

skills.name: Time and priority management
skills.description: Organising work across multiple accounts in a fast-paced, growing team environment.
skills.assessment_scope: Balancing competing demands, meeting deadlines, and focusing on high-impact activities.

skills.name: Listening and needs discovery
skills.description: Actively listening to customers to uncover needs, goals, and potential opportunities.
skills.assessment_scope: Using questions to probe, clarifying statements, and synthesising what matters most to the client.

skills.name: Persuasion and influencing
skills.description: Influencing customer decisions in favour of proposed solutions and growth opportunities.
skills.assessment_scope: Structuring arguments, handling objections, and gaining commitment without damaging relationships.

skills.name: Collaboration in fast-paced teams
skills.description: Working effectively with colleagues in a growing, fast-paced team environment.
skills.assessment_scope: Sharing information, coordinating activities, and adapting to change alongside others.

skills.name: Product and service understanding
skills.description: Understanding the company’s offerings well enough to align them with customer needs and success goals.
skills.assessment_scope: Explaining key features and benefits and mapping them to client situations.

skills.name: Opportunity pipeline management
skills.description: Maintaining and progressing a pipeline of upsell and cross-sell opportunities within accounts.
skills.assessment_scope: Tracking, prioritising, and updating opportunity stages to support growth targets.

skills.name: Results orientation
skills.description: Focusing on achieving defined revenue, retention, and growth goals.
skills.assessment_scope: Setting targets, monitoring progress, and adjusting efforts to meet or exceed objectives.

skills.name: Adaptability to growth environment
skills.description: Adjusting to evolving processes, priorities, and structures in a growing organisation.
skills.assessment_scope: Comfort with change, learning new ways of working, and staying effective amid uncertainty.

skills.name: Professional written communication
skills.description: Writing clear, concise, and professional emails and documents for clients and colleagues.
skills.assessment_scope: Structuring messages, tone control, and clarity when handling account issues and growth proposals.

skills.name: Professional verbal communication
skills.description: Speaking confidently and professionally in calls and meetings with customers and teammates.
skills.assessment_scope: Clarity, tone, and confidence when managing conversations and presenting ideas.

skills.name: Basic data and metrics awareness
skills.description: Using simple account and revenue metrics to guide decisions and prioritisation.
skills.assessment_scope: Interpreting basic performance data to focus efforts on the right accounts and opportunities.

skills.name: Customer service
skills.description: Providing prompt, friendly and helpful support to customers on the shop floor.
skills.assessment_scope: How they interact with customers, respond to questions, and ensure a positive shopping experience.

skills.name: Shop floor communication
skills.description: Clearly communicating with customers and team members on the shop floor.
skills.assessment_scope: Ability to listen, explain products or policies, and check understanding in a busy store.

skills.name: Handling returns and exchanges
skills.description: Processing returns and exchanges in line with store rules while keeping customers satisfied.
skills.assessment_scope: How they apply policies, handle potentially upset customers, and resolve simple issues.

skills.name: Restocking and merchandising
skills.description: Keeping shelves filled, tidy and visually appealing for customers.
skills.assessment_scope: Approach to organising stock and maintaining a neat, easy-to-shop environment.

skills.name: Basic cash handling
skills.description: Accurately taking payments, giving change and following simple till procedures.
skills.assessment_scope: Comfort with cash and card transactions and checking amounts are correct.

skills.name: Cashing up at close
skills.description: Reconciling the till at the end of the day so totals balance with sales.
skills.assessment_scope: Attention to detail and following steps to count and record cash accurately.

skills.name: Following store procedures
skills.description: Consistently applying store rules for returns, exchanges, cashing up and security.
skills.assessment_scope: Reliability in following instructions and standard operating procedures.

skills.name: Reliability for shifts
skills.description: Turning up on time and consistently for scheduled late and weekend shifts.
skills.assessment_scope: Track record and attitude toward punctuality, attendance and flexible working hours.

skills.name: Teamwork in-store
skills.description: Working cooperatively with a young, energetic team on the shop floor.
skills.assessment_scope: How they support colleagues, coordinate tasks and maintain a positive team atmosphere.

skills.name: Dealing with busy periods
skills.description: Staying calm and effective when the store is crowded or under time pressure.
skills.assessment_scope: Ability to prioritise tasks and keep service standards up during rushes.

skills.name: Basic problem solving
skills.description: Using common sense to resolve simple customer or stock issues on the spot.
skills.assessment_scope: How they think through small problems and know when to ask for help.

skills.name: Physical stamina on feet
skills.description: Sustaining energy and focus while standing and moving around the store for long periods.
skills.assessment_scope: Comfort with active, on-your-feet work throughout a shift.

skills.name: Safe stock handling
skills.description: Lifting and moving stock deliveries and items safely and carefully.
skills.assessment_scope: Awareness of safe handling practices and care when dealing with physical stock.

skills.name: Attention to detail
skills.description: Noticing small errors or issues in pricing, tills, stock levels or displays.
skills.assessment_scope: Care in checking work, spotting discrepancies and correcting them.

skills.name: Security and closing routines
skills.description: Carrying out opening and closing checks to keep the store safe and secure.
skills.assessment_scope: Following checklists and taking responsibility for basic security steps.

skills.name: Learning store systems
skills.description: Picking up till systems and simple in-store technology quickly.
skills.assessment_scope: Comfort with learning and using basic retail systems and scanners.

skills.name: Professional attitude
skills.description: Maintaining a polite, respectful and customer-focused manner at work.
skills.assessment_scope: Overall work ethic, responsiveness to feedback and willingness to help.
